title: MTI Consulting: Best Boutique Management Consultancy MEA 2021
author: CFI.co Editorial
content_html: Bahrain-based MTI Consulting was founded in 1997 by international thought-leader Hilmy Cader. Since its inception, MTI has completed some 670 projects in 49 countries — eliciting pages of positive feedback from clients. It works across a range of industries to solve some of the most pressing modern business challenges. The company has established a network of boutique consultancy firms in 30 countries, powered by a team of consultants, analysts, researchers, functional specialists and experts in various fields. MTI Consulting helps clients to analyse and strategize and can assist with planning, corporate restructuring, international expansion, growth and transformation. It advises on how to tweak operational processes and systems, enhance performance, optimise talent and implement digitalisation. It can also facilitate M&As and financial restructuring for corporate finance clients. MTI employees are guided by a values system that encourages situational prudence and calculated risk. They share a mindset of limitless possibilities and seek out opportunities for learning and improvement. The team is bottom-line-driven and thinks in terms of strategic simplicity. The members interact with clients through value-adding communication based on respect and integrity. Company actions are underpinned by clear processes, quality planning, and a bias for closure. MTI Consulting has conceptualised breakthrough models that successfully challenge conventional thinking. Its work has been showcased and presented at 150 conferences around the world. The CFI.co judging panel announces MTI Consulting as winner of the 2021 award for Best Boutique Management Consultancy (MEA).
